conclusion: InvestigationBudgetContinuation.decide handles budget requests by detecting REQUEST_BUDGET tool calls. When a valid budget request is found (line 212), it returns Finish("investigation_budget_requested") (line 221) to stop the current turn without another LLM call. When no budget request is detected or validation fails, it delegates to the inner continuation runtime (line 222). Budget approval is not automatic - the parent must explicitly use decide_investigation_budget tool to grant tokens, and the child does not automatically continue work after requesting; the parent must send further work if needed.
